hook.line: If she had a realtor as a client, here are the content ideas she'd put in their strategy.
hook.visual: She is cut out over a collage: keys handed over, an agent with a SOLD sign, a couple at a house, with a serif 'CONTENT IDEAS FOR REALTORS' title across the middle.

beats.what: Green-screen collage with the series title; the promise of a realtor content plan is spoken in the first sentence.
Cut to her in a green-walled room for a quick intro of herself, her agency and the niche series.
Cut to a realtor's TikTok profile full of listing posts while she names the big mistake: selling the house, not the neighborhood.
Listing flyers float around her as she explains listings lose relevance once sold.
Idea one, area content: cutaways to aerial neighbourhood footage, coffee shops and parks.
A map with a red location pin holding her face illustrates 'become the digital mayor' of the city.
Idea two, education: cutaway of another creator explaining the home buying process.
Big serif 'PEOPLE SAVE' title over her head marks educational content as the saveable kind.
Idea three, comment-a-keyword lead capture, shown with a screen recording of a comment thread getting automated replies.
Closing line and 'WHAT NICHE ... NEXT' title asking viewers to pick the next episode.

why_it_works: Hypothetical 'if I had a realtor as a client' frames the tips as a paid strategy given away, so realtors stay for the plan.
A named mistake (selling the house instead of the neighbourhood) comes before the ideas, so each idea answers a problem.
Every idea is shown with a cutaway (profile, aerial, map pin, comment thread), changing the picture about every 3.4 s median shot.
Episode of a niche series that ends by asking which niche is next, which drives comments and return visits.
weaknesses: The self-introduction from about 4 to 12 s delays the first idea in an 81 s video.
Captions are small (2.3% median text height) and 73% of text sits outside the safe area.
Two CTAs (save and comment the next niche) compete in the last seconds.
for_robert: Use the 'which niche/topic next?' ending of a series: Fred could hold up a blank sign at the end asking viewers to fill in the next episode, turning the CTA into a comment prompt.
